name: Han Jumin
source:
Occupation: Executive director
Likes: Cats (Elizabeth 3rd), symmetrical patterns, striped patterns

Comes from a wealthy family. A selfish pragmatist. His driving skill is bad. Currently raising a cat named Elizabeth 3rd.
